products.name: Automation Anywhere
products.note: Intelligent automation platform; AI-powered bots; control room governance; credential vault

profile_text.body:
Automation Anywhere is a California-based automation software company founded in 2003. The company describes itself as the number one provider of agentic automation, and positions its platform as combining artificial intelligence, robotic process automation, and agentic process automation to handle mission-critical enterprise workflows. Its platform includes an orchestration layer it calls the Mozart Orchestrator, which the company says coordinates AI agents, deterministic automations, and human workers together.

The company's primary product is an intelligent automation platform that includes AI-powered bots, a control room for governance, and a credential vault for security. The platform is aimed at enterprise use cases including IT service management, where the company says it can boost employee self-service, reduce IT service desk workload, and predict major incidents through AIOps. The site cites a Gartner observation that more than 90 percent of so-called agentic AI solutions are repackaged generative AI, implying its own platform falls among the smaller group delivering genuine agent-driven orchestration.

The held facts show Automation Anywhere has a notable litigation footprint, with 175 cases tracked in California. No MCP server registrations or SEC filings are recorded in the available data.
